We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 5 reactions, using templates in order: ['29646', '1914389', '1914390', '149040', '1914391'].

We have applied 29646 to target, got three possible precursors (list of three). Need to choose one that can be further processed with next template 1914389, then 1914390, then 149040, then 1914391.

We need to construct a tree: root molecule target, child reaction with template 29646, children are precursors (maybe choose one). Then for each precursor, apply next template etc.

We need to find a chain of 5 steps leading to simple buyable precursors.

We have some results: applying 29646 gave three precursors:

1. 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C' (has silyl protecting group)
2. 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO' (silyl on acid)
3. 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO' (silyl on alcohol)

We need to apply template 1914389 next. We tried applying to first precursor (with silyl on side chain) and got result: two precursors: 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C' and 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC' (some side product). That seems plausible.

Now we need to apply template 1914390 to each of those? We tried applying to first product (with silyl) and got empty. Maybe need to apply to second product? We tried applying to 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC' and got empty.

Maybe we need to choose a different precursor from 29646 that works better.

Let's try applying 1914389 to second precursor (silyl on acid).
